title: Meet Portugal

body.heading: Where in the world is Portugal?
paragraphs: Portugal is a country in Southern Europe, which is part of Europe.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Portugal is Lisbon.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: The language you will hear most in Portugal is Portuguese.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Portugal is the euro. The euro is shared by many countries in Europe, so the same coins and notes work across borders.

body.heading: How big is Portugal?
paragraphs: Portugal covers about 92,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about three times the size of Belgium.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Lisbon rides seven hills: taste custard tarts in Belém by its tower and monastery, then ride tram 28 through the Alfama's tiled lanes to a castle view.
The Algarve's golden cliffs hide caves like Benagil, where a skylight opens above a secret beach — boat and kayak trips explore them all.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Find Portugal on a map or globe. Which continent is it on — and can you name a country that sits next to it?
2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?

takeaway: Portugal in one breath: a country in Southern Europe, capital Lisbon, where people speak Portuguese and pay with the euro.
materials: A globe, atlas or world map (to find Portugal)
Paper and crayons or pencils for the screen-free mission
